description: Nonlinear element for the response shaper
notes: Breath is unipolar so only one ever conducts in play; the second covers the power-on and fault excursions. Scaling is set at /2 so the knee lands at about a quarter of a hard blow - at /10 it would sit ABOVE the playing range and the control would do nothing until you overblow. *** THE 0.6 V KNEE THIS SHAPER DEPENDS ON IS NOT-IN-DOCUMENT AS A SPEC. *** Neither banked datasheet specifies V_F at 0.6V; it is readable only off Vishay's TYPICAL Fig.1 (~1mA at 25degC), and that curve shifts more than 100mV LEFT at 150degC - on a part whose entire behaviour is where the knee sits. The tightest SPECIFIED bound in the bank is Diotec's V_F < 0.855V at 10mA. *** BUY VISHAY'S 1N4148W-E3-08, *** a true SOD-123 (Document 86356 Rev 1.0: 2.7 x 1.55mm body, R-thJA 440 K/W, P_tot 280mW, V_F <=1V at 10mA, C_D 1.5pF max) - Diotec's same-numbered part is SOD-123F, flat lead, no standoff, and the plain 1N4148 is axial DO-35. LCSC C241939

ALPHA RV09AF-40-25B-B50K-0C: RV09A = 280 deg like the R0904N on the other two knobs, -40 vertical, 25B = 25mm shaft of the B type, which is 18-TOOTH knurled like the T18 knob (the K type is 40-tooth), B50K linear, 0C = centre click [ds RV09AF-40.pdf p.1 order code, p.3 outline, p.7 B type]. Song Huei lists a centre click in its specification but no order code for it [ds R0904N.pdf p.1], so this is the one Alpha on the panel. Same 5.0mm pin pitch, 10.6mm lug span and 7.0mm offset as the R0904N [RV09AF-40.pdf p.3, R0904N.pdf p.2], so it takes the same footprint. *** THE CENTRE DETENT IS HONESTLY WARRANTED HERE AND NOT ELSEWHERE: *** at centre the wiper sits at exactly 0V by topology - it spans +Vin/2 and -Vin/2 - so the nonlinear branch carries no current and the stage is linear. POT-OFFSET gets no detent: its zero is not at centre. The click costs half the rotational life, 5000 cycles against 10000 [p.1]

SETS HOW HARD 'FULLY EXPONENTIAL' BENDS: the owner requires at least 1.5x at a hard blow (2026-09-30), and 3.9k is the E24 value that holds it at every simulated corner - shaper-exp-gain, module/breath-response-shaper/sim. Lower bends harder and clips earlier; the next E24 value up, 4.3k, falls under 1.5x at the worst corner. POT-RESP's track tolerance is most of the spread, so a pot measured low at incoming inspection is where to look first if a unit reads short. UNI-ROYAL 0805W8F3901T5E, LCSC C17614

description: The 2 x 10k divider that makes V_in/2 for the pot's top end
notes: TWO, and they must MATCH rather than be accurate: the null at centre detent is exact only while the divider gives exactly half of what the inverting stage gives back. That null is the reason this pot earns a centre detent where POT-OFFSET's does not. 0805W8F1002T5E, LCSC C17414

description: Feedback resistor (drawn R2) of the shaping stage
notes: The /2 comes from R-RESP-FB over R-RESP-IN, and the /2 is the whole design: at /10 the diode knee lands above a hard blow and the knob does nothing until you overblow. Do not rescale either without re-checking the knee against the playing range. 0805W8F1002T5E, LCSC C17414

description: Input resistor (drawn R1) of the shaping stage
notes: Sets the shaping stage's input current against R-RESP-FB, so the pair is what makes it divide by two. 0805W8F2002T5E, LCSC C4328

description: Response shaper: 1/2 shapes at /2 inverting, 1/2 restores x2 inverting
notes: Response-shaper op-amp. DEVICE FACTS ARE ON U-OPA-PITCH; not repeated here. ITS OWN PACKAGE, BOTH HALVES THE SHAPER'S: A shapes at /2 inverting, B restores x2 inverting so scale and polarity at POT-GAIN are the in-amp's. The six U-OPA-PITCH packages keep their two spare halves (U-REF-BUF B, U-MOD-C B). LCSC C139363

description: Input resistor of the shaper's restoring half (x2 inverting)
notes: V_shaped into U-RESP B's (-) input. With R-RESTORE-FB it undoes the shaping half's -1/2, so at centre detent the stage is exactly unity and the polarity is the in-amp's. 0805W8F1002T5E, LCSC C17414

description: Feedback resistor of the shaper's restoring half
notes: U-RESP B's output to its (-) input: -20k/10k = -2. The stage's output is BREATH_SHAPED, into POT-GAIN. 0805W8F2002T5E, LCSC C4328
